Print a soil_gmm object

Source: R/soil_classification_risk_src.R
print.soil_gmm.Rd

Compact summary of a fitted soil mixture model: the selected model and cluster count, the BIC gap to the runner-up, cluster sizes, the number of uncertain sites, and the per-cluster profile means in original units.

The BIC gap is reported because a point estimate of the zone count is misleading on its own. Differences are graded weak (< 2), positive (2-6), strong (6-10) and very strong (> 10). A weak gap means several partitions fit about equally well.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'soil_gmm'
print(x, ...)

Arguments

x

an object of class soil_gmm.

...

ignored.

Value

x, invisibly.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
fit <- soil_classification(soil_grid, risk.vars = "soc")
print(fit)
} # }
